_comment: Settings for node serve.js. Edit, save, then restart. Delete this file to reset.
_help_port: Port number to serve on (1-65535). Keep it the same: saved classes belong to one port.
_help_host: Address to listen on. 0.0.0.0 = reachable by phones, 127.0.0.1 = this computer only.
_help_open: Open a browser window when the server starts (true/false).
_help_openAddress: Which address to open on this computer: 'localhost' (recommended), 'wifi', or 'none'.
_help_wifiAddress: Pin the address shown for phones. Empty means detect it.
_help_autoPort: If the port is busy, try the next one (true/false). A new port starts with empty storage.
